decisions: CSharp specialization requires exact canonical std.crypto.aes128.Key.encryptBlock, nonasync, actual Key struct receiver, one additional parameter, zero captures and static array return.

SLG specialization currently checks module hash and bare encryptBlock name, parameter count and captures but not Key owner or return/receiver kinds. A same-namespace top-level function and OtherKey method must remain ordinary functions. This source observation requires actual native reproduction before editing.

Reuse full logical namespace comparison; require actual root Key nominal receiver, instance impl Key owner, nonasync/static result and matching arity before emitting specialization. Preserve portable/AES dispatch and require original1226 positive to retain actual AES intrinsic code.
